304-1742-1978-3363.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
304-1742-1978-3363.description:
Animate The One Ring using Tough Cookie.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-7426-7628-7811.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2092-7426-7628-7811.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1309-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and exiling Ephemerate.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

677-4050-4217-5211.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
677-4050-4217-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lutri, adding one mana of any color.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana of each color that you didn't add in step 5.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-4050-4217-5211.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control two or more creatures.
198-4067-6281-7206.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

1274-2034-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1322-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-5175-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5175-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4231-4508-5880-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3678-6879-6905.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-6879-6905.description:
Play Darigaaz's Caldera.
When Darigaaz's Caldera enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Darigaaz's Caldera.
Resolve the Darigaaz's Caldera trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Darigaaz's Caldera from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2770-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2014-3055-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

3951-4192-4772-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4192-4772-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2558-4742-5226-5687.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2061-2239-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2061-2239-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1495-3921-4120.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3921-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-3921-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

245-466-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
245-466-2034.description:
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1285-3664-4222.notablePrerequisites: Lotus Field does not have summoning sickness.
1285-3664-4222.description:
Activate Mishra's Groundbreaker by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Lotus Field to become a 3/3 artifact creature that's still a land.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, attaching it to Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

280-1479-2374.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-2374.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

385-1069-2459-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mortarpod attached to Rograkh.
You control at least three artifacts.
385-1069-2459-4763.description:
Activate Rograkh by sacrificing it.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rograkh ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Repeat.

865-997-2429.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten in any combination of Treasures and/or creatures.
865-997-2429.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Mahadi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any creature you control, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat step 2 until you control no creatures.
Resolve the Mahadi trigger from step 1, creating a Treasure token for each creature that died this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.

424-434-868.description:
Cast Lava Spike, targeting yourself.
Splice Desperate Ritual onto Lava Spike.
Hold priority and activate Mirror Sheen, targeting Lava Spike.
Have the copy of Lava Spike target another player.
Resolve the copy of Lava Spike.
Using the RRR from the copy of Lava Spike's text from Desperate Ritual, activate Mirror Sheen, targeting Lava Spike.
Repeat.
Cast Lava Spike by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Lava Spike.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Lava Spike, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting an opponent.
Resolve Lava Spike, dealing damage to an opponent and adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
